message:
VAT is now 25% in `src/vat.js`, and the tests pass (2/2).

Changes:
- **`src/vat.js`**: the multiplier is now `1.25` (was `1.2`), and the comment says 25%.
- **`test/vat.test.js`**: the expected values are updated to match. `1000` → `1250`, `999` → `1249`, and `250` → `313`.

The only other 20% reference was the test name, which now reads "adds 25% VAT". There are no docs or config files that mention the rate.

`250` is an exact half-penny (`312.5`), so it rounds up to `313` under `Math.round`. If your accounting rules round half-pennies differently, that line needs a different rounding rule.

I haven't committed anything. I also took the 25% rate from your message and didn't check it against any official source.
